signature.why: The lifegain engine and its payoff. Martyr turns a hand of white cards into a life total no aggro deck can beat and Serra Ascendant is a 6/6 flying lifelink for one mana the moment it does; a build with neither is a different white deck. Owner judgement rather than a field count: statistics_decks returns no orzhov blink list at all today, which is why this deck's shell is declared a brew.

The blink half the archetype is named for: something that re-triggers an enters ability, and enough enters abilities to be worth re-triggering. Martyr of Sands is a one-shot without it, so this clause and the one above are the same engine described from its two ends.

A white-based orzhov manabase. Martyr of Sands reveals white cards and Solitude pitches one, so the deck is mono-white with a black splash rather than a two-colour deck, and the count is what makes that claim checkable offline.
